answer: Plume-Gated Delegation Caps. Each identity may delegate work only under a capped plume of sub-keys, and every sub-key activation requires a fresh yarrow token minted by solving a per-identity, time-locked puzzle whose solution is bound to that identity's prior output fable. Cloning forces the attacker to re-mint the entire plume serially, so each marginal clone adds puzzle work without adding throughput; past a small threshold the clone's expected earnings fall below its marginal minting cost.
